title: Clean invoice, exact PO match
description: Text PDF, tax shown separately, explicit PO reference, amount matches the PO exactly.

title: Bundled line, tax embedded, $26 over PO
description: Different layout and date format. One bundled line with tax embedded. Amount is $26 (0.3%) over the PO, inside tolerance.

title: No PO number on the invoice
description: The invoice never mentions a PO. The process infers it from vendor and amount and flags that it did so.

title: Split PO: month 1 of 3
description: One PO, three monthly invoices. Approved as a partial invoice; the PO balance drops to $8,640.

title: Split PO: month 2 of 3
description: Same vendor, same amount, a month later. NOT a duplicate. Approved; PO balance drops to $4,320. Run after 04a.

title: Split PO: invoice exceeds remaining balance
description: Third invoice includes $8,000 of unplanned extras and would push total billing past the PO. Held. Run after 04a and 04b.

title: Resubmitted with a changed invoice number
description: Vendor resends sample 01 as 'INV-NW-2041A' with a date one day later. The invoice number differs, so an exact check misses it. Run after 01.

title: Scanned image, no invoice number or date
description: Image-only scan that needs OCR. The vendor left off the invoice number and date. The process holds it and drafts a specific question to the vendor instead of guessing.

title: Lookalike vendor name + new bank account
description: 'Northwlnd' (l instead of i), a different bank account, and a 'we changed banks' note. Classic business-email-compromise pattern. Escalated, payment blocked.

title: Correct vendor, bank account changed
description: The vendor name is exactly right but the bank account differs from the vendor master. Escalated for a call-back verification.

title: Vendor not in the approved list
description: An invoice from a company that is not an approved vendor. Rejected outright.
